# TASK-075 — specification

## Scope

Separate API and web images: `docker/api.Dockerfile` (API and worker) and `docker/web.Dockerfile` (nginx with CSP and security headers, SPA deep links).

## Acceptance criteria

- Not recorded. Add acceptance criteria here before changing this task.

## Verification

- pnpm smoke:web

## Notes

Both images built; worker start-up through Git Bash needed `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV`. `pnpm smoke:web` (`scripts/smoke-web-image.ts`) builds the web image, runs it against a stub API and passes 15 checks: health, CSP and security headers on the shell and assets, no-cache shell, immutable gzip assets, deep-link fallback, 404 for missing assets, `/api` proxy with forwarded scheme. Added to the CI `docker` job.
